description: Bakersfield Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping destination spanning 240,068 square feet along California Avenue in Bakersfield's thriving retail corridor. This open-air community center attracts an impressive 4 million annual visits, anchored by popular national retailers including Burlington Stores, Ross Dress for Less, and a top-performing Hobby Lobby location that ranks among the highest-visited in California. The center offers a diverse mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options, featuring In-Shape Health Clubs, AMC Theatres, Panera Bread, and Lassens Natural Foods & Vitamins, creating a one-stop destination for the local community. Strategically positioned with high visibility from California Avenue's 36,000 daily vehicle traffic and convenient access to Route 99 with over 160,000 vehicles per day, the plaza serves a dense population of more than 102,000 residents within 3 miles. The property's strong tenant roster and excellent accessibility have established Bakersfield Plaza as a cornerstone retail hub in Kern County, meeting the everyday shopping, dining, and entertainment needs of Bakersfield's growing community.
